storeListingCopy.fullDescription:
SERP TellaTV Downloader makes it easy to save videos from Tella.tv to your computer.

How it works: Navigate to any Tella video page or a page with an embedded Tella video. Press play on the video, then click the download button that appears on the player or click the extension icon in your toolbar. The extension detects the signed HLS stream, shows the video details, and downloads it as a standard MP4 file.

Tella uses signed CloudFront streaming with expiring manifest URLs. This extension handles all of that automatically — detecting manifests from multiple sources, refreshing expired signatures, and converting the HLS stream to MP4 entirely within your browser. No external tools, no command line, no technical knowledge required.

Key features:
- Automatic detection of Tella's signed HLS manifests
- In-page download button overlay on the video player
- Converts HLS streams to standard MP4 files in your browser
- Intelligent signed URL refresh when manifests expire
- Works on Tella.tv pages and Tella embeds on other websites
- Real-time download progress with speed indicators
- Download manager panel with cancel and progress tracking
- Clean UI with indigo blue accents
- 3 free downloads to try before you buy

Getting started:
1. Install the extension
2. Go to any Tella.tv video page or page with a Tella embed
3. Press play on the video
4. Click the overlay download button or the extension icon
5. Download saves as MP4

Sign in with your email to unlock 3 free trial downloads. Upgrade to a license for unlimited downloads.

Supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Firefox, and more.

faq.question: How do I download a Tella video?
faq.answer: Go to any Tella.tv video page and press play. Then click the download button that appears on the player, or click the extension icon in your toolbar.

faq.question: Does this work with Tella videos embedded on other websites?
faq.answer: Yes. The extension scans all frames on the page and detects Tella embeds on any website, not just tella.tv.

faq.question: What format are downloaded videos?
faq.answer: All videos are saved as standard MP4 files that play on any device or media player.

faq.question: Why do I need to press play first?
faq.answer: Tella uses signed streaming URLs that are only generated when playback starts. The extension needs the stream to load before it can detect and download the video.

faq.question: What if the download fails with an expired URL error?
faq.answer: The extension automatically attempts to refresh expired manifest URLs. If it still fails, press play on the video again and retry the download.

faq.question: How many free downloads do I get?
faq.answer: 3 free trial downloads after signing in with your email. Purchase a license for unlimited downloads.

faq.question: Does this work on Firefox?
faq.answer: Yes — supports Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Whale, Yandex, and Firefox.

faq.question: Is my data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. All video processing happens entirely in your browser. Authentication uses secure OTP — no passwords stored.

faq.question: Can I download my own Tella recordings?
faq.answer: Yes. If you can view the recording in your browser, the extension can detect and download it.
